watch_list.summary: Grok Bot can now place phone calls for you; ask it to handle a live call like rebooking or checking hours.
Try having your Bot call an airline and rebook a flight when plans change.
Watch the short guide on building, sharing, and feeding Pages with your own data and X posts.
Give each Bot one job, a clear brief, and ongoing training instead of treating it like a one-shot assistant.

trendy.summary: Spin up a Bot that watches for posts beating your average, then rewrites winners for LinkedIn, Instagram, and Shorts.
Drop footage in Drive, let the Bot storyboard and first-edit, revise on low-res, then render full-res once at the end.
Have a Bot read every app privacy policy on your phone, flag ones that sell data, and email deletion requests.
Wire iOS Shortcuts + Vocal Shortcuts so saying “Hey Grok” opens voice chat even when the phone is locked.
Paste the one-page Chief of Staff template (shared history, no self-grading, timed routines) before you grow past six bots.
